integrity: All odd primes; exact algebraic proof supplemented by 15 finite-prime Hasse-Witt computations. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Geometric a-number and p-rank only. General Ciani decomposition and CM reduction are prior theory. No full Ekedahl-Oort classification or full polarization; unindexed exact-family overlap remains possible.
title: The four residue classes of the geometric \(a\)-number of the Chebyshev plane quartic
